```{ojs}
// === Helper Functions

// Load results from JSON
results = FileAttachment("results.json").json({ typed: true })

ticks_per_second = results.TimerResolution

// Function to format bytes
function formatBytes(bytes) {
  if (bytes >= 1e15) return (bytes / 1e15).toFixed(2) + " PB";
  if (bytes >= 1e12) return (bytes / 1e12).toFixed(2) + " TB";
  if (bytes >= 1e9)  return (bytes / 1e9).toFixed(2) + " GB";
  if (bytes >= 1e6)  return (bytes / 1e6).toFixed(2) + " MB";
  if (bytes >= 1e3)  return (bytes / 1e3).toFixed(2) + " KB";
  return bytes + " B";
}

// Function to format time
function formatTime(seconds) {
  if (seconds >= 3600) return (seconds / 3600).toFixed(2) + " h";
  if (seconds >= 60)   return (seconds / 60).toFixed(2) + " min";
  if (seconds >= 1)    return seconds.toFixed(2) + " s";
  if (seconds >= 1e-3) return (seconds * 1e3).toFixed(2) + " ms";
  if (seconds >= 1e-6) return (seconds * 1e6).toFixed(2) + " µs";
  return (seconds * 1e9).toFixed(2) + " ns";
}

// Short format for axis labels
function formatBytesAxis(bytes) {
  if (bytes >= 1e12) return (bytes / 1e12).toFixed(1) + " TB";
  if (bytes >= 1e9)  return (bytes / 1e9).toFixed(1) + " GB";
  if (bytes >= 1e6)  return (bytes / 1e6).toFixed(1) + " MB";
  if (bytes >= 1e3)  return (bytes / 1e3).toFixed(1) + " KB";
  return bytes + " B";
}

function formatTimeAxis(seconds) {
  if (seconds >= 3600) return (seconds / 3600).toFixed(1) + " h";
  if (seconds >= 60)   return (seconds / 60).toFixed(1) + " min";
  if (seconds >= 1)    return seconds.toFixed(1) + " s";
  if (seconds >= 1e-3) return (seconds * 1e3).toFixed(1) + " ms";
  if (seconds >= 1e-6) return (seconds * 1e6).toFixed(1) + " µs";
  return (seconds * 1e9).toFixed(1) + " ns";
}
```

## Overview

```{ojs}
// Compute summary metrics
totalBytes = Object.values(results.IOOperations).reduce((sum, op) => sum + (op.Bytes || 0), 0)
totalTime = Object.values(results.IOOperations).reduce((sum, op) => sum + ((op.MetaOperationTime || 0) + (op.TransferOperationTime || 0)), 0) / ticks_per_second
totalOps = Object.values(results.IOOperations).reduce((sum, op) => sum + (op.Count || 0), 0)
numFiles = results.Files ? results.Files.length : 0

// Display metrics in a row
html`<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 1rem; margin: 1rem 0;">
  <div class="card">
    <div class="metric-value">${formatBytes(totalBytes)}</div>
    <div class="metric-label">Total I/O</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="metric-value">${formatTime(totalTime)}</div>
    <div class="metric-label">Total I/O Time</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="metric-value">${totalOps.toLocaleString()}</div>
    <div class="metric-label">I/O Operations</div>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="metric-value">${numFiles}</div>
    <div class="metric-label">Files Accessed</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

## I/O by Paradigm

```{ojs}
// Extract IOOperations by paradigm
ioData = Object.entries(results.IOOperations).map(([paradigm, ops]) => ({
  paradigm,
  bytes: ops.Bytes || 0,
  metaTime: (ops.MetaOperationTime || 0) / ticks_per_second,
  transferTime: (ops.TransferOperationTime || 0) / ticks_per_second,
  count: ops.Count || 0

color = d3.scaleOrdinal(d3.schemeTableau10)
```

## Local Access Patterns

*Analysis of I/O access patterns detected per file*

```{ojs}
// Aggregate access pattern data across all files
accessPatternData = (results.Files || []).reduce((acc, file) => {
  const ticks = file["Ticks spent per Access Pattern"] || {};
  const ioSizes = file["I/O sizes per Access Pattern"] || {};
  
  Object.entries(ticks).forEach(([pattern, val]) => {
    if (!(pattern in acc)) acc[pattern] = { ticks: 0, bytes: 0 };
    acc[pattern].ticks += (val || 0);
    acc[pattern].bytes += (ioSizes[pattern] || 0);
  });
  return acc;
}, {});

// Convert to array
accessPatternArray = Object.entries(accessPatternData).map(([pattern, val]) => ({
  pattern: pattern.replace(/^AccessPattern::/, ""),
  ticks: val.ticks,
  bytes: val.bytes,
  time: val.ticks / ticks_per_second
}));

// Remove empty patterns
meaningfulPatterns = accessPatternArray.filter(d => d.bytes > 0 || d.time > 0)
```

## Global Access Pattern Analysis

*Approximation of global access patterns by aggregating across all MPI ranks*

```{ojs}
// Aggregate by number of accessing locations (ranks)
byLocationCount = (results.Files || []).reduce((acc, file) => {
  const nrLocs = file["Nr accesses from different locations"] || 0;
  const ticks = file["Ticks spent per Access Pattern"] || {};
  const ioSizes = file["I/O sizes per Access Pattern"] || {};
  
  if (!acc[nrLocs]) acc[nrLocs] = { 
    locations: nrLocs, 
    files: 0, 
    bytes: 0, 
    time: 0,
    patterns: { CONTIGUOUS: 0, STRIDED: 0, RANDOM: 0, NONE: 0 }
  };
  acc[nrLocs].files += 1;
  acc[nrLocs].bytes += (file["#Bytes read"] || 0) + (file["#Bytes write"] || 0);
  acc[nrLocs].time += ((file["Ticks spent on I/O"] || 0) + (file["Ticks spent on Metadata"] || 0)) / ticks_per_second;
  
  Object.entries(ticks).forEach(([pat, t]) => {
    const patName = pat.replace(/^AccessPattern::/, "");
    acc[nrLocs].patterns[patName] = (acc[nrLocs].patterns[patName] || 0) + (t || 0);
  });
  return acc;
}, {});

locationArray = Object.values(byLocationCount).sort((a, b) => b.bytes - a.bytes)
```

### I/O by Number of Accessing Ranks

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  caption: "Total I/O grouped by number of MPI ranks accessing the file",

  marks: [
    Plot.barX(locationArray, {
      y: d => d.locations + (d.locations === 1 ? " rank" : " ranks"), 
      x: "bytes", 
      fill: "#3498db",
      sort: { y: "x", reverse: true }
    })
  ]
})
```

### Dominant Access Pattern per File Count

```{ojs}
// Find dominant pattern per file
filePatternDominance = (results.Files || []).map(file => {
  const ticks = file["Ticks spent per Access Pattern"] || {};
  const ioSizes = file["I/O sizes per Access Pattern"] || {};
  
  // Find pattern with most bytes
  let dominant = "NONE";
  let maxBytes = 0;
  Object.entries(ioSizes).forEach(([pat, bytes]) => {
    if ((bytes || 0) > maxBytes) {
      maxBytes = bytes;
      dominant = pat.replace(/^AccessPattern::/, "");
    }
  });
  return {
    file: (file.FileName || "").split("/").pop(),
    dominant,
    bytes: maxBytes,
    locations: file["Nr accesses from different locations"] || 0
  };
}).filter(f => f.bytes > 0);

// Count files by dominant pattern
patternFileCounts = filePatternDominance.reduce((acc, f) => {
  acc[f.dominant] = (acc[f.dominant] || 0) + 1;
  return acc;
}, {});

patternCountArray = Object.entries(patternFileCounts).map(([pat, count]) => ({
  pattern: pat,
  count
})).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);

Plot.plot({
  caption: "Number of files by dominant access pattern",
  marginLeft: 80,
  y: { label: null },
  x: { label: "File Count" },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(patternCountArray, {
      y: "pattern", 
      x: "count", 
      fill: d => color(d.pattern),
      sort: { y: "x", reverse: true }
    })
  ]
})
```

## Top Files

### Top 10 Files by I/O Size

```{ojs}
// Helper: find common prefix
function commonPrefix(strings) {
  if (!strings.length) return "";
  let prefix = strings[0];
  for (let str of strings.slice(1)) {
    let i = 0;
    while (i < prefix.length && prefix[i] === str[i]) i++;
    prefix = prefix.slice(0, i);
    if (!prefix) break;
  }
  return prefix;
}

function getBasePath(path) {
  const lastSlash = path.lastIndexOf("/");
  return lastSlash !== -1 ? path.slice(0, lastSlash + 1) : "";
}
```

```{ojs}
// Top files by total I/O (read + write)
topFiles = (results.Files || [])
  .filter(f => f["#Bytes read"] > 0 || f["#Bytes write"] > 0)
  .map(f => ({
    ...f,
    totalBytes: (f["#Bytes read"] || 0) + (f["#Bytes write"] || 0),
    totalTime: ((f["Ticks spent on I/O"] || 0) + (f["Ticks spent on Metadata"] || 0)) / ticks_per_second
  }))
  .sort((a, b) => b.totalBytes - a.totalBytes)
  .slice(0, 10);

// Strip common prefix
commonPrefixStr = topFiles.length > 1 
  ? commonPrefix(topFiles.map(f => f.FileName))
  : getBasePath(topFiles[0]?.FileName || "");

Inputs.table(
  topFiles.map(f => ({
    File: f.FileName.replace(commonPrefixStr, ""),
    "Read": formatBytes(f["#Bytes read"] || 0),
    "Write": formatBytes(f["#Bytes write"] || 0),
    "Time": formatTime(f.totalTime),
    "Paradigm": (f.IoParadigm || []).join(", ")
  })),
  { columns: ["File", "Read", "Write", "Time", "Paradigm"] }
)
```

```{ojs}
// Create detailed file table with access patterns
fileDetails = (results.Files || [])
  .filter(f => Object.keys(f["Ticks spent per Access Pattern"] || {}).length > 0)
  .map(f => {
    const patterns = f["Ticks spent per Access Pattern"] || {};
    const sizes = f["I/O sizes per Access Pattern"] || {};
    return {
      File: f.FileName.split("/").pop(),
      "Total I/O": formatBytes((f["#Bytes read"] || 0) + (f["#Bytes write"] || 0)),
      "CONTIGUOUS": formatBytes(sizes["AccessPattern::CONTIGUOUS"] || 0),
      "STRIDED": formatBytes(sizes["AccessPattern::STRIDED"] || 0),
      "RANDOM": formatBytes(sizes["AccessPattern::RANDOM"] || 0),
      "NONE": formatBytes(sizes["AccessPattern::NONE"] || 0)
    };
  });
```
